title: Delegated Records args envelope is lost in server request-local tool definitions
reproduction: Native reproduction is pending. The server source regression seam is packages/matrx-ai/tests/test_args_envelope.py::test_browser_inline_merge_delegates_flat_arguments (introduced in aidream commit 549b4064d1).
Use the Records guide call {"action":"guide","args":{"topic":"table_list"}}; expected tool_delegated arguments for the published Chrome handler are {"action":"guide","topic":"table_list"}.

For native acceptance, invoke a read-only Records guide and a parameterized list/read through the published Chrome extension, then confirm the displayed result reflects the requested topic and arguments.
expected: Server delegation preserves or normalizes the Records args envelope so the published Chrome handler receives its declared flat arguments and applies the requested guide topic, read parameters, and list limit.
actual: Source trace showed browser-dom projecting the live DB tool row into InlineToolSpec input_schema.properties, then merge_request_tools stashing a request-local ToolDefinition from only that projection. ToolExecutor.execute preferred that projected definition over the DB registry row, so $envelope/$variants were absent and args unwrapping was skipped. Aidream source repair 549b4064d1 preserves registry dispatch metadata; independent source acceptance 8266fee4 accepted the scoped fix. Hosted deployment run 37097006365 integrated source 23053275714b3401ff514339706635f8fc051d0d; live deployment verification remains pending. Native reproduction and acceptance are pending. The independent oracle confirmed the canonical guide-parity assertion does not establish Chrome handler compatibility. This is separate from the repaired initial Chat-start failure.
evidence: Aidream source repair 549b4064d1; independent source acceptance 8266fee4; hosted deployment run 37097006365 integrated source 23053275714b3401ff514339706635f8fc051d0d (live server deployment verification pending).
